title: RoboAuto: Autonomous Robot Program Search through Multi-Level Physical Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.36533v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recently, LLM-based autonomous agents have shown strong capabilities in iteratively generating, evaluating, and refining executable solutions. In robotic manipulation, Code-as-Policy lets these agents search over modular and editable robot programs. However, effective program search requires physical understanding: agents must understand how objects can be manipulated, how scene geometry constrains actions, and why interactions succeed or fail. Existing methods rely mainly on execution feedback for program refinement, often leaving these physical questions unresolved. We introduce RoboAuto, a framework for robot program search that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels through three components. translated_title: RoboAuto：通过多层次物理理解实现自主机器人程序搜索
translated_abstract: 近年来，基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体在迭代生成、评估和改进可执行方案方面展现出强大能力。在机器人操作领域，Code-as-Policy 使这些智能体能够在模块化、可编辑的机器人程序中进行搜索。然而，有效的程序搜索需要物理理解能力：智能体必须理解物体如何被操作、场景几何如何约束动作，以及交互为何成功或失败。现有方法主要依赖执行反馈来改进程序，往往无法解决这些物理层面的问题。我们提出了 RoboAuto，这是一个机器人程序搜索框架，通过三个组件在物体、场景和交互三个层次上显式地组织物理理解。首先，一个分层知识库将可执行技能与以物体为中心的知识（包括可供性、空间关系和动作效果）相结合，这些知识从具身数据和在线任务中学习获得……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: RoboAuto 提出了一个在物体、场景和交互三个层次上显式组织物理理解的机器人程序搜索框架，利用分层知识库整合可执行技能与物体中心知识，使基于 LLM 的智能体能够更有效地搜索和改进机器人操作程序。
en_tdlr: RoboAuto is a robot program search framework that explicitly organizes physical understanding at the object, scene, and interaction levels, using a hierarchical knowledge base that combines executable skills with object-centric knowledge to enable LLM-based agents to more effectively search and refine robotic manipulation programs.
